component.name: ComposeDeck
component.summary: Manage Docker Compose projects with Podman

description.p: ComposeDeck is a desktop app for managing Docker Compose projects running on Podman.
It scans a folder for compose projects, shows which services are running, and lets you start, stop, and restart individual apps or all of them at once.

ul.li: Overview of all compose projects with running, stopped, and partial states
Per-project service list with health, ports, and logs
Start, stop, and restart controls for single services or whole projects

description.p: ComposeDeck talks directly to the Podman API socket and does not require a separate Compose binary.
